results.title: Katy Perry slams White House after using her song 'Firework' in military strike video
results.description: Katy Perry is speaking out after the White House's official TikTok account used her song “Firework” in a video showing footage of military strikes. The video, posted last Thursday, featured lyrics from her Grammy-nominated album "Teenage Dream", including the words "boom, boom, boom," played over clips of bombs exploding. Its caption read: "Iran has been warned." Expressing her frustration, Katy posted on X (formerly known as Twitter), saying, "I am deeply appalled and angry to see ‘Firework’ used on the @WhiteHouse TikTok account as a backing track for video footage of military strikes. I did not approve this, I was not asked, and I absolutely do not condone it." “I wrote this song to be an anthem of hope, healing, and inner strength for people going through their darkest personal moments,” she continued. "To see a message of self-worth and upliftment weaponized to soundtrack destruction and violence is a complete violation of everything my song stands for." Katy concluded her statement: "My music is for bringing people together, not celebrating warfare." Earlier this year, Kesha condemned the White House for using her song "Blow" on TikTok featuring fighter jets in the sky with the caption, "Lethality."

results.title: Breaking News: Bihar Protest Row Deepens as Siwan Policeman Suspended, Opposition Targets Government in Parliament
results.description: The political controversy surrounding student protests in Bihar has intensified after a viral video from Siwan allegedly showed a police constable firing a rifle during demonstrations held amid the Bihar Bandh. The incident has sparked sharp political reactions, with opposition parties demanding accountability and raising the issue in Parliament. According to officials, the suspended personnel has been identified as SIT constable Abhishek Patel. Authorities have initiated an inquiry into the incident, while senior police officials have stated that a probe is underway to determine the circumstances surrounding the use of force during the protest. Opposition leader Tejashwi Yadav alleged that the constable fired at protesting students and questioned the deployment of such a weapon during crowd control. Reports also claimed that three students were injured during the unrest, though authorities have not officially confirmed whether the injuries were linked to the firing shown in the viral video. The controversy is expected to reverberate in Parliament, with opposition parties planning to press the government over police action against students and broader concerns regarding examination reforms. DMK MP T.R. Baalu has also submitted an adjournment motion seeking an urgent discussion on the NEET issue and demanding an investigation into the alleged use of lethal weapons during student demonstrations. The latest developments have added fresh political momentum to the ongoing debate over education reforms, student protests, and law enforcement practices. As investigations continue, both the Bihar administration and the Central Government are likely to face renewed scrutiny over the handling of protests and the measures taken to maintain public order.

Tejashree Pradhan On Veen Doghantli Hi Tutena Dialogue Free Episode: झी मराठीवरची (Zee Marathi) 'वीण दोघांतली ही तुटेना' (Veen Doghatli Hi Tutena) ही मराठी मालिका (Marathi Serial) सध्या तुफान गाजतेय. तेजश्री प्रधान (Tejashree Pradhan) आणि सुबोध भावे (Subodh Bhave) स्टारर या मालिकेनं अल्पावधीतच प्रेक्षकांच्या मनात अढळ स्थान निर्माण केलंय. सध्या कथानकात समर आणि स्वानंदी यांच्या नात्याला वेगळं वळण मिळताना दिसतंय. मालिकेतले समर आणि स्वानंदी एकमेकांच्या प्रेमात आकंठ बुडालेत. अशातच आता मालिकेत वेगवेगळे ट्वीस्ट पाहायला मिळालेत. प्रेक्षकांची आवड आणि टीआरपीची गणित सांभाळत मालिकेत आजवर अनेक प्रयोग करण्यात आलेत, पण आता मालिकेत एक आगळा-वेगळा आणि कदाचित यापूर्वी कधीच न करण्यात आलेला प्रयोग करण्यात येणार आहे.

तेजश्री प्रधान आणि सुबोध भावेंच्या सध्या तुफान गाजत असलेल्या 'वीण दोघांतली ही तुटेना' मालिकेत एक आगळावेगळा एपिसोड टेलिकास्ट केला जाणार आहे. या एपिसोडची खासियत म्हणजे, यामध्ये एकही डायलॉग असणार नाही. कलाकार एकमेकांशी संवाद साधणार नाहीत, तर फक्त खाणाखुणा करूनच आपलं म्हणणं एकमेकांना सांगणार आहेत. त्यामुळे आता प्रेक्षकांनाही या एपिसोडची उत्सुकता लागली आहे. अनेकजण सोशल मीडियावर पोस्ट करुन हा एपिसोड कधी टेलिकास्ट होणार? याबाबत विचारणा करत आहेत.

पुढे बोलताना तेजश्री प्रधान म्हणाली की, "आम्हाला हा भाग करताना फार मज्जा आली. मालिकेतील सगळ्याच कलाकारांनी अनेक चांगली कामं केलीत. त्यामुळे हा ऐपिसोड करण्यासाठी कोणला वेगळी तयारी करावी लागली नाही. यामध्ये फक्त एकमेकांकडून बघून केलेले एक्स्प्रेशन्स आहेत. आम्हाला हे सीन करताना जशी मजा आली, तशीच तुम्हाला सुद्धा हा भाग पाहताना येईल..."

results.title: What are the main events for today?
results.description: EUROPEAN SESSION In the European session, the only highlight is the German IFO which is expected to tick higher to 86.0 vs 85.6. The IFO is generally correlated with the Composite PMI, so the expectations are skewed to the upside. The data won't change anything for the ECB though, so the market reaction will likely be muted. The markets are currently being driven by optimism as the US and Iran halted strikes over the weekend. Traders are obviously taking this as an early sign of potential de-escalation and that's why we are seeing crude oil and the US dollar falling, while stocks, gold and bonds rally. AMERICAN SESSION In the American session, we get the US Durable Goods Orders data which is expected to show a 1.8% increase vs -4.5% contration last month. This is almost never a market moving release due to its volatile nature. The Fed is focused on inflation, so nobody's going to care about durable goods data anyway. The focus will remain on US-Iran headlines as traders will be on the lookout for further signals of de-escalation or a return to risk-off in case we go back to last week's conditions. This article was written by Giuseppe Dellamotta at investinglive.com.
